title: TD Talk: two columns on wide screens, and old voice notes no longer download on open
text: On wide screens TD Talk now keeps the chat list in a left column and opens the chat beside it; phones still show one screen at a time. Opening a chat also no longer downloads all its old voice notes: only the newest one is loaded ahead so it plays at once, and older ones load when you tap them.
points: The open chat's row is highlighted, and its unread number is hidden while it is on screen.
New voice-note uploads are kept by the browser for a year, so they are not fetched again every time.
